guitar.evidence: Joe Trohman has used various guitars including Les Pauls and Jazzmasters; not tied to one iconic model.
guitar.notes: Artist name appears malformed (likely a song-title fragment), treated as Fall Out Boy.

tone.target: bright pop-punk crunch with chorus sheen
tone.profile: bright pop-punk crunch with chorus sheen
tone.summary: A clean boost and Chorus module feed into a Fender-style US Deluxe amp, providing the necessary bright pop-punk foundation. A light OD pedal adds grit for the crunchy parts, while Digital Delay provides rhythmic depth.
corrections: drop delay as core unless clearly audible
make crunch tighter and less pop-rock generic
keep chorus as the key texture

rig.name: Fall Out Boy-Sugar, We're Going Down - Band Arrangement - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain tight recording quality.
Provide subtle lift and punch for the arpeggios and crunchy sections.
blocks.gap: The Boost module is ideal for adding controlled, non-distorted lift without coloring the tone too much.

blocks.purpose: Add the necessary tight crunch and grit for the pop-punk elements without sounding muddy.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is chosen over Blues OD or OD 9 to maintain a brighter, more modern punk edge.

blocks.purpose: Implement the required chorus/modulation sheen. While a dedicated Chorus module exists, C-Wah offers a versatile modulation effect suitable for pop textures.
blocks.gap: The ideal choice is a dedicated Chorus module (if available), but since it's listed under WAH, we use C-Wah to fulfill the modulation requirement. We will treat this as the primary chorus source.

blocks.purpose: Placeholder for potential secondary distortion stage (kept off).

Match the bright, articulate sound of the US Deluxe amp.
Enhance the bright treble and cut any potential low-end muddiness.
Add rhythmic depth and space without dominating the core pop-punk sound.
Provide subtle ambient space to glue the arpeggios and chords together.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR/Cabinet for increased clarity and modern pop-punk articulation.

proposals.reason: Enhance high-end sparkle and definition needed for bright pop-punk arpeggios.
